provenance: reference/quantity-reconciliation-gates.md (G+.29 to G+.32) and reference/universal-rules.md (G+.25 to G+.28)
stage: 3.5 - after derivation, before formatting. An unresolved FAIL blocks output.

G+.25.name: Fabrication-token scan
G+.25.exception: the token sits inside a quoted drawing label
G+.25.action: move the line to AN.SUBSTANTIVE and drop its confidence to LOW

levels.HIGH: verbatim from a schedule, a dimension or a specification
levels.MED: explicit derivation citing a drawing or an extraction record, on HIGH base values

G+.27.name: Percentage / factor scan
G+.27.action: measure the real quantity; keep the factor as a memo line
G+.27.catches: a formwork reuse factor entering a quantity - measure contact area, reuse is a memo

G+.28.name: Pattern-check omission
G+.28.rule: do not add elements because they are customary - kickers, water stops, weep holes, access hatches
G+.28.action: measure only what the evidence shows; an allowance is raised for the user to decide

completeness.name: Completeness matrix
completeness.matrix: evidence source -> BOQ section -> row count
completeness.override: a FAIL converts to PASS only with a written justification in AN.RECONCILIATION

rows.detail: waterproofing in G, wall tile in J, floor drains in Q
joinery in F, entry doors in H

rows.note: R, not S. There is no POMI section S.

mass_balance.record_as: check # | expected | actual | variance % | PASS/FAIL | action

checks.check: sum of floor finish areas in J vs sum of room.area_m2 x floor_count
checks.on_breach: re-measure; list rooms with no finish code

checks.check: RC slab area in C vs sum of geometry.floor_areas GFA
checks.on_breach: use structural GFA; slab must be >= sum of net room areas

checks.check: blockwork m2 vs (sum of wall lengths once x average height - openings)
sum of door rows in H vs sum of schedules.doors counts, after the R36 guard
sum of window rows in H vs sum of schedules.windows
sanitary fixture count vs wet room count
plaster/paint m2 <= 2 x blockwork m2 + external wall inner faces
skirting lm vs sum of (room.perimeter - door widths) x floor count
total BOQ slab area vs the measured built-up area
any material or system appearing in more than one section - insulation, waterproofing, paint
checks.rule: must reconcile to ONE building total across sections
checks.on_breach: list rows per section; remove the duplicate billing

checks.check: CAD blocks representing double-faced or paired devices - EXIT-DOUBLE, EM-DOUBLE
checks.rule: count as ONE unit per pair
checks.on_breach: re-count from block definitions, not block faces

checks.check: a fixture count exactly equal to the count of another building element
checks.on_breach: verify the CAD layer or tag actually represents the fixture before billing

rate_sanity.status: REDESIGNED - see data/rate_classes.json. The stored rate library is withdrawn, so the library min/max envelope no longer exists. The guard is now three market-independent tests: corroboration, spread, and the ordinal invariants.
